title: Clinic design and fit-out, Dublin 1
role: Design and build fit-out: MF designed the reception, waiting areas and joinery
summary: We designed the reception and waiting areas, drew the joinery and then built it: a slatted, illuminated reception desk, timber wall panelling and storage.
intro: The practice asked us for the interior design and the fit-out together. We prepared the layout, 3D views, finishes and lighting, and detailed drawings for the reception desk and panelling.
The works followed the design closely. The photographs below show the design views beside the finished rooms.
